title: Small steps: Predictable is not negotiable
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Use the voice safety needs, then teach, reconnect and preserve dignity.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
practice: state what will happen next and follow through
principle: Make limits predictable without turning them into endless negotiation.
nextSentence: The reasonable limit remains. First, state what will happen next and follow through.
keyLearning: Make limits predictable without turning them into endless negotiation.
